ShortDescription.Value: Custom zones that grow only the buildings you choose, from any theme, region pack or custom asset.

Publish.LongDescription:
Real Zoning & Building Themes brings the idea of Building Themes from the first game to Cities: Skylines II. Create your own zones, paint them with the normal zoning tools, and decide exactly which buildings grow in each.
# Zones that look like real places Make a streetcar suburb of narrow detached houses, a main street of attached mixed use, or a strip of low commercial. Each zone has rules for: - Use, including mixed use and low rent - Theme or region pack - Height - Lot width and depth - Side setbacks (attached, narrow or detached) - Parking on the lot
Then include or exclude any building by hand, with thumbnails and Find It style filters.
# Every building you have Vanilla, DLC, region packs and custom assets. Custom assets are grouped by the pack they came from.
# Works like a game zone Each zone is based on a game zone and shares its demand, services and icon. Buildings level up within the zone's rules and keep the same design where they can. If you tighten a zone's rules, buildings that no longer fit are condemned and replaced, as the game does.
# Managing zones Open the panel with the building button at the top left. Create, duplicate, retire, restore and delete zones. Zones are shared by all your cities; where you paint them is saved with each city.
# Compatibility - Plop the Growables: supported. Plopped buildings are left alone and its despawn setting is honoured. - Find It: works alongside it. - Zone Organizer: supported. Custom zones keep their own tab. - Requires Unified Icon Library.
# Before uninstalling Saves store painted cells by zone. Before removing the mod, open each city, press **Prepare for uninstall** at the bottom of the zone list, and save. Otherwise those cells load unzoned and their buildings are condemned.
# Translations English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Korean, and Simplified and Traditional Chinese. All but English are machine translated; corrections are welcome.
# Credits Includes code adapted from Plop the Growables by algernon (Apache 2.0) and Custom Zones by dvovo (MIT). Inspired by Building Themes by boformer.
